channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Andrew Bogut | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Andrew Bogut from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Richard Jefferson on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“He's a grumpy dude, so I 100% think he is built to coach. No, but the thing I like about Bogut is he has a respect for the game of basketball. He has an appreciation and a respect. Now his grumpiness is part of that. I think most great players and talented players have a grumpiness when it comes to the sport. And I think he's going to be outstanding. I think he's going to demand high amounts of focus from his teammates and from his players. And he also carries a tremendous amount of respect.”

Richard Jefferson on Andrew Bogut, Sep 10, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Who are your top three defensive teammates of all time? Andrew Bogut number one, Klay Thompson number two. Klay Thompson, ball hawk. And I'd say number three, number three, my favorite defensive teammate of all time, or not favorite, but top three. Kevin Durant was elite defensively here. Elite. Andre Iguodala. Andre Iguodala made the game really easy. Got to go with Andre. It has to be Andre.”

Draymond Green on Andre Iguodala, Kevin Durant, Andrew Bogut, Klay Thompson, Jun 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Anthony Edwards
item.description:
MrBuckBuck:Draymond Green on Memphis hotel:

“[Anthony Edwards] is pretty blunt about it, but yeah. We stopped staying there because their sprinklers just went off for no reason in the room... Drenched all of [Andrew] Bogut's stuff, and they didn’t want to do anything about it. So, it’s been an issue.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Anthony Edwards, Feb 23, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brian Goorjian on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Goorjian has won six NBL titles as a coach and worked with Bogut in the Boomers setup.

“Being a three-time Olympian and an NBA champion, Andrew has a blue-chip pedigree,”

Brian Goorjian on Andrew Bogut, Mar 12, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova
item.description:
Mills says, before repeating himself.

“I don't say that necessarily as a good thing. We definitely have got some work to do in this area, I believe, but for now it's full focus on Tokyo,and a gold medal would do wonders for our program, as at least a starting point. There's a prestigious feeling within our program that needs to be a joint effort between the playing group and Basketball Australia to make sure when -- we've lost 'Bogues' [Andrew Bogut], obviously -- I step away, when Joe Ingles steps away, 'Delly' [Matthew Dellavedova], [Aron] Baynes -- that that program is still elite, if not even more levels up, as it should be.”

Patty Mills on Andrew Bogut, Joe Ingles, Aron Baynes, Matthew Dellavedova, Jan 13, 2021. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Larry Sanders on Brandon Jennings, Keyon Dooling, Drew Gooden, Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“I played with Brandon Jennings, Monte Ellis, Drew Gooden, Keyon Dooling, Andrew Bogut and I had great teammates,”

Larry Sanders on Brandon Jennings, Keyon Dooling, Drew Gooden, Andrew Bogut, Jun 1, 2020. Source: CBS Chicago.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Kerr told The Daily Telegraph.

“I think it was really good for him to play in Sydney. Part of that was just being home. It’s a better lifestyle than the NBA. But yeah,(Bogut returning to the Warriors) is something that I’d be into again.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Aug 27, 2019. Source: news.com.au.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“What he did for the Boomers in that win against Team USA didn’t surprise me. Andrew just seems rejuvenated to me. From a few years ago to now, he is playing better than he has in years.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Aug 27, 2019. Source: news.com.au.

item.title: Andrej Lemanis on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Lemanis said of the criticism directed at Simmons.

“Ben's at the high end of that (criticism) because of the superstar status that he carries. But I saw when Bogut was coming through and people used to get on him. These guys are passionate about playing for their country, and they want to play.”

Andrej Lemanis on Andrew Bogut, Aug 13, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Jeremy Loeliger on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“We want Andrew to come back to the Kings. Don’t get me wrong. But we also want him to come over to the NBA. We want him to win a championship with the Warriors. That’s fantastic press for us back home.”

Jeremy Loeliger on Andrew Bogut, Apr 30, 2019. Source: San Jose Mercury-News.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Kevon Looney
item.description:
Mark Medina:Steve Kerr on handling minutes for Andrew Bogut and Kevon Looney:

“Bogut and Kevon have been fantastic. Both are playing at a very high level. If I didn’t play those guys, I'd be an idiot.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Kevon Looney, Apr 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Draymond:

“So many times you see shot blockers who can't really think. They can just block a shot. With Bogut, he's behind you reading the same situation you're reading. So he has a better feel of when to cover up, when not to. It keeps everyone in position.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Apr 20, 2019. Source: Twitter @anthonyVslater.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Logan Murdock:Steve Kerr on what he think the reaction will be when Andrew Bogut takes the floor tonight:

“I think he’s going to get more than a warm reception. I think he’s going to get a raucous reception.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Mar 21, 2019. Source: Twitter @loganmmurdock.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut:

“It'll take him about five minutes to pick up the offense because it's basically the same as it was when he was here. ... I wouldn't hesitate to put him in.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Mar 8, 2019. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“My first day out at Golden State he was teaching me different things you could do that you couldn’t do in college and throughout the course of that year just teaching me positioning. “I wouldn’t be half the defender I am without Andrew Bogut. He taught me so much about defence that I owe all my success to him, defensively.”

Draymond Green on Andrew Bogut, Jun 6, 2018. Source: news.com.au.

item.title: Ivica Zubac on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Ivica Zubac on Andrew Bogut:

“Great teammate. He was a great teammate for everybody. He helped me so much with him being able to speak Croatian. Helped me a lot.”

Ivica Zubac on Andrew Bogut, Jan 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Walton told Ireland and Thompson.

“You can anchor our defense, you can pass the ball. The fact that you're a champion around our young players is something that could be huge for us.' … Bogut had other teams that were interested in him obviously, but he chose us.”

Luke Walton on Andrew Bogut, Sep 21, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“Teams would get by us on the perimeter and finish at the rim. So we addressed that with a guy like Andrew Bogut,who can come in and be a paint protector. I think the roster is retrofitted for better defense.”

Rob Pelinka on Andrew Bogut, Sep 21, 2017. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: LeBron James on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
#Cavaliers FLeBron James on Andrew Bogut's fractured left leg vs. #Heat:

“I heard it break as soon as it happened. I heard it crack.”

LeBron James on Andrew Bogut, Mar 6, 2017. Source: Twitter @BrianDulik.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Mark Cuban:

“As well as Deron was playing and even Andrew defensively ... we had to match up to our criteria of trying to position ourselves to get a lot better. Then you combine that with the fact that I've always said, when a lot of teams are tanking, you don't want to tank. And when there aren't many teams tanking and everybody's trying to compete, that's the best time to consider trying to go for a draft pick. You can try to play as well as you can and still be in competition for a great pick.”

Mark Cuban on Andrew Bogut, Feb 26, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
The solution, at least for now: Move Bogut to the bench and make Nowitzki a full-time center.

“I don’t like this from the standpoint that Bogut is a starting center,”

Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut, Jan 4, 2017. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“Andrew basically talked to me about his willingness to come off the bench if that’s the best thing for the team so we have that as an option,”

Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut, Jan 3, 2017. Source: Fort Worth Star-Telegram.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki on Andrew Bogut:

“That's a guy that's obviously been around & won -- a champion. Everybody has got to sacrifice a little bit.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Andrew Bogut, Jan 2, 2017. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes:

“I'm looking forward to seeing both of them tonight. I've stayed in touch with both of them.”

Steve Kerr on Andrew Bogut, Harrison Barnes, Nov 9, 2016. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Dwain Price:Carlisle on Andrew Bogut:

“I love his feel as a player and I really feel like he’s making a lot of progress with his free throw shooting.”

Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut, Oct 26, 2016. Source: Twitter @DwainPrice.

item.title: Dirk Nowitzki on Stephen Curry, Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Earl K. Sneed:Dirk Nowitzki on Andrew Bogut:

“He sets unbelievable screens. Playing with him the last two weeks, it's no wonder Steph (Curry) was always open.”

Dirk Nowitzki on Stephen Curry, Andrew Bogut, Oct 6, 2016. Source: Twitter @EarlKSneed.

item.title: Deron Williams on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“It's going to be great to see how he handles being a go-to guy. He's kind of been in the shadows (at Golden State). We'll see what he can do now with the ball in his hands. And I'm looking forward to playing with big Bogut. I've been a fan of his for awhile. He's definitely a player point guards like to play with.”

Deron Williams on Andrew Bogut, Aug 26, 2016. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
“I think we can be a better defensive team, because of Bogut, and I think we’ll be a more physical defensive team from top to bottom. And then it’s going to come down to style,”

Rick Carlisle on Andrew Bogut, Aug 17, 2016. Source: mavs.com.

item.title: Andrej Lemanis on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
Sean Deveney:AUS coach Andrej Lemanis on Andrew Bogut:

“Unbelievable what he's done just to get himself right to be here. I can't speak more highly of him”

Andrej Lemanis on Andrew Bogut, Aug 10, 2016. Source: Twitter @SeanDeveney.

item.title: Mark Cuban on Andrew Bogut
item.description:
And Cuban is pulling for his new center, who scored 18 points to lead the Aussies to an 87-66 victory over France on Saturday in the opening game of the tournament.

“We obviously were nervous and I'm still not a fan of NBA players in the Olympics, but Andrew was going to have to go through a process to get back on the court anyway,”

Mark Cuban on Andrew Bogut, Aug 8, 2016. Source: ESPN.
